advice: Experiment: in the LIBXSMM-generated K loops, test replacing the current load-then-add pointer updates with post-indexed contiguous loads, keeping predicates, loaded values, and FMOPA order unchanged. The hardware profile states SME2 and 16 FP32 lanes; it does not establish operand alignment, so this experiment must not assume aligned inputs. Hypothesis: post-index addressing may reduce separate address updates. This is unverified advice, not a performance claim.
risks: Confirm Apple clang 21 accepts the exact SME2 load form and that its post-index behavior advances by the intended bytes. Audit pointer rewind and row traversal in both loops; preserve all valid lane bounds and avoid reads past each row. Check generated assembly and run the fixed correctness suite, including general sizes, tails, and n<=0. Then use fresh paired measurements against unchanged controls on the current power source and report spread. Reject any gain that does not meet the existing eligibility and promotion rules. Do not infer a cause from instruction count or noisy scores.
